  <script type="text/babel">
    const { useState, useEffect, useRef, useMemo } = React;

    // =========================================================================
    // 1. UNIVERSAL TRANSMISSIONS CATALOG (28 MAJOR HISTORIC & MODERN FAMILIES)
    // =========================================================================
    const TRANSMISSIONS_DB = {
      powerglide: { id: "powerglide", name: "GM Powerglide (2-Speed Auto)", type: "Automatic", ratios: [1.76, 1.00], reverse: 1.76, defaultStall: 3500, clutch: "5-Clutch High Gear / Kevlar Band", pattern: "GM_Chevy_V8", desc: "Lightweight drag racing 2-speed automatic with planetary gear set." },
      th350: { id: "th350", name: "Turbo-Hydramatic 350 (TH350 3-Speed Auto)", type: "Automatic", ratios: [2.52, 1.52, 1.00], reverse: 2.07, defaultStall: 2400, clutch: "5-Clutch Direct / Heavy-Duty Sprag", pattern: "GM_Chevy_V8", desc: "Compact GM 3-speed automatic with low rotating mass. Perfect street match." },
      th400: { id: "th400", name: "Turbo-Hydramatic 400 (TH400 3-Speed HD)", type: "Automatic", ratios: [2.48, 1.48, 1.00], reverse: 2.08, defaultStall: 3000, clutch: "6-Clutch Forward / 34-Element Sprag", pattern: "GM_Chevy_V8", desc: "Virtually indestructible transmission handling 1,000+ HP." },
      r7004: { id: "r7004", name: "700R4 / Early 4L60 (4-Speed Overdrive)", type: "Automatic", ratios: [3.06, 1.63, 1.00, 0.70], reverse: 2.29, defaultStall: 2200, clutch: "Z-Pack 3-4 Clutch / Corvette Servo", pattern: "GM_Chevy_V8", desc: "Deep 3.06 first gear launch with 30% highway overdrive." },
      r4l60e: { id: "r4l60e", name: "GM 4L60E (Electronic 4-Speed Overdrive)", type: "Automatic", ratios: [3.06, 1.63, 1.00, 0.70], reverse: 2.29, defaultStall: 2400, clutch: "Electronic PWM Lockup / Heavy Duty Clutches", pattern: "GM_Chevy_V8", desc: "Electronic computer-controlled 4-speed overdrive with programmable shift tables." },
      r4l80e: { id: "r4l80e", name: "GM 4L80E (Heavy Duty Electronic 4-Speed OD)", type: "Automatic", ratios: [2.48, 1.48, 1.00, 0.75], reverse: 2.08, defaultStall: 2600, clutch: "Overdrive Planetary + Heavy Duty TH400 Core", pattern: "GM_Chevy_V8", desc: "Heavy duty 4-speed overdrive capable of holding 1,200+ HP." },
      r10l90: { id: "r10l90", name: "GM / Ford 10L90 (10-Speed Performance Auto)", type: "Automatic", ratios: [4.70, 2.99, 2.15, 1.80, 1.52, 1.28, 1.00, 0.85, 0.69, 0.64], reverse: 4.87, defaultStall: 2200, clutch: "4 Planetary Sets / 6 Multi-Plate Clutches", pattern: "GM_LS_Modular", desc: "Ultra-close ratio 10-speed keeping engine pinned in peak horsepower." },
      muncieM20: { id: "muncieM20", name: "Muncie M20 Wide-Ratio (4-Speed Manual)", type: "Manual", ratios: [2.52, 1.88, 1.46, 1.00], reverse: 2.59, defaultStall: 0, clutch: "11.0\" 10-Spline / 27-Spline Organic", pattern: "GM_Chevy_V8", desc: "Wide-ratio 4-speed designed for 3.08 to 3.55 highway rear axle ratios." },
      muncieM21: { id: "muncieM21", name: "Muncie M21 Close-Ratio (4-Speed Manual)", type: "Manual", ratios: [2.20, 1.64, 1.28, 1.00], reverse: 2.27, defaultStall: 0, clutch: "11.0\" 26-Spline / 32-Spline Heavy Duty", pattern: "GM_Chevy_V8", desc: "Close-ratio manual designed to keep high-revving SBC 350 in the powerband." },
      muncieM22: { id: "muncieM22", name: "Muncie M22 'Rock Crusher' (4-Speed Manual)", type: "Manual", ratios: [2.20, 1.64, 1.28, 1.00], reverse: 2.27, defaultStall: 0, clutch: "11.0\" SFI Billet Steel Flywheel + 26-Spline Disc", pattern: "GM_Chevy_V8", desc: "Low-helix straight-cut gears for maximum torque tolerance and legendary M22 whine." },
      tremecT5: { id: "tremecT5", name: "Tremec T5 World-Class (5-Speed Manual OD)", type: "Manual", ratios: [2.95, 1.94, 1.34, 1.00, 0.63], reverse: 2.76, defaultStall: 0, clutch: "10.4\" Diaphragm Clutch / Carbon Synchros", pattern: "GM_Chevy_V8", desc: "Compact 5-speed overdrive with 0.63:1 fifth gear for highway cruising with 3.73 rear gears." },
      tremec_tkx: { id: "tremec_tkx", name: "Tremec TKX (Compact 5-Speed Manual 600 ft-lbs)", type: "Manual", ratios: [2.87, 1.89, 1.28, 1.00, 0.68], reverse: 2.56, defaultStall: 0, clutch: "26-Spline Input / Multi-Lip Seals / 8,000 RPM Synchros", pattern: "GM_Chevy_V8", desc: "The ultimate restomod 5-speed. Slim case fits into classic muscle car floorpans with zero tunnel cutting." },
      tremecT56: { id: "tremecT56", name: "Tremec T56 Magnum (6-Speed Manual Double OD)", type: "Manual", ratios: [2.66, 1.78, 1.30, 1.00, 0.80, 0.63], reverse: 2.90, defaultStall: 0, clutch: "Twin-Disc SFI Ceramic / Hydraulic Throwout", pattern: "GM_Chevy_V8", desc: "Heavy-duty 6-speed manual with double overdrive capable of handling 700+ ft-lbs torque." }
    };

    // Universal Fail-Safe Orbit Controls
    function setupUniversalOrbitControls(camera, domElement, targetVec = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1.0, 0)) {
      if (typeof THREE.OrbitControls === 'function') {
        try {
          const ctrl = new THREE.OrbitControls(camera, domElement);
          ctrl.enableDamping = true;
          ctrl.dampingFactor = 0.05;
          ctrl.target.copy(targetVec);
          return ctrl;
        } catch (e1) {}
      }
      return { update: () => {}, dispose: () => {} };
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // 2. MAIN APPLICATION COMPONENT WITH REAL-TIME COORDINATION
    // =========================================================================
    function SBC350App() {
      // COORDINATED GLOBAL TABS
      const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('block3d');
      // 'block3d' | 'rotating' | 'valvetrain' | 'induction' | 'ignition' | 'trans' | 'dyno' | 'shop'

      // =======================================================================
      // CENTRAL COORDINATED ENGINE PARAMETERS (RAY'S CONFIRMED BASELINE SPECS)
      // Changing ANY of these automatically updates all 8 tabs & calculations!
      // =======================================================================
      const [bore, setBore] = useState(4.000);              // in (Ray's Baseline)
      const [stroke, setStroke] = useState(3.480);          // in (Ray's Baseline)
      const [rodLength, setRodLength] = useState(5.700);    // in (Ray's Baseline: 5.700")
      const [deckHeight, setDeckHeight] = useState(9.025);   // in (Ray's Baseline: 9.025")
      const [deckClearance, setDeckClearance] = useState(0.015); // in (Ray's Baseline: 0.015")
      const [gasketThickness, setGasketThickness] = useState(0.039); // in (Ray's Baseline: 0.039")
      const [chamberCc, setChamberCc] = useState(64.0);      // cc (Ray's Baseline: 64.0cc)
      const [pistonReliefCc, setPistonReliefCc] = useState(5.0); // cc (4-eyebrow flat top)

      // Valvetrain & Induction Parameters
      const [camProfile, setCamProfile] = useState('street'); // 'rv' | 'street' | 'radical'
      const [rockerRatio, setRockerRatio] = useState(1.5);    // 1.5:1 or 1.6:1
      const [selectedIntake, setSelectedIntake] = useState('dualplane_rpm'); // 'dualplane_rpm' | 'singleplane_victor' | 'tunnelram_dual'
      const [carbCfm, setCarbCfm] = useState(650);           // CFM (Ray's Baseline: 650 CFM)

      // Ignition & Tuning Parameters
      const [ignitionTiming, setIgnitionTiming] = useState(36); // Degrees Total Timing (36° optimal)
      const [targetAFR, setTargetAFR] = useState(12.9);       // Air-Fuel Ratio (12.9:1 optimal)
      const [sparkPlugGap, setSparkPlugGap] = useState(0.040);// in

      // Transmission & Chassis Parameters
      const [selectedTrans, setSelectedTrans] = useState('th350');
      const [stallSpeed, setStallSpeed] = useState(2400);     // Torque Converter Stall RPM
      const [rearGear, setRearGear] = useState(3.73);
      const [tireDiameter, setTireDiameter] = useState(26.0); // in
      const [selectedVehicle, setSelectedVehicle] = useState('camaro1969');

      // 3D Visualizer Modes
      const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState('realistic'); // 'realistic' | 'ghost'
      const [cutawayMode, setCutawayMode] = useState('rightBank'); // 'none' | 'rightBank' | 'centerLongitudinal' | 'valvetrain'
      const [explodedAmount, setExplodedAmount] = useState(0);
      const [rpm, setRpm] = useState(850);
      const [isRunning, setIsRunning] = useState(false);

      // Header Height Measurement Ref
      const headerRef = useRef(null);
      const [headerHeight, setHeaderHeight] = useState(140);

      useEffect(() => {
        if (headerRef.current) {
          setHeaderHeight(headerRef.current.offsetHeight || 140);
        }
      }, []);

      // =======================================================================
      // BI-DIRECTIONAL REAL-TIME COORDINATION ENGINE
      // Every formula is derived from thermodynamic machine-shop physics!
      // =======================================================================
      const coordinatedSpecs = useMemo(() => {
        // 1. Displacement & Geometry
        const displacementCi = +((Math.PI / 4) * Math.pow(bore, 2) * stroke * 8).toFixed(1);
        const displacementL = +(displacementCi * 0.0163871).toFixed(2);
        const cylinderCc = +((displacementCi * 16.3871) / 8).toFixed(1);

        // 2. Quench Distance (Ray's Confirmed Equation: .039" gasket + .015" deck)
        const quenchDistance = +(gasketThickness + deckClearance).toFixed(3);

        // 3. Compression Volumes & Static Compression Ratio
        const deckVolumeCc = +(((Math.PI / 4) * Math.pow(bore, 2) * deckClearance * 16.3871)).toFixed(2);
        const gasketVolumeCc = +(((Math.PI / 4) * Math.pow(4.100, 2) * gasketThickness * 16.3871)).toFixed(2);
        const totalClearanceCc = +(chamberCc + gasketVolumeCc + deckVolumeCc + pistonReliefCc).toFixed(2);
        const staticCR = +((cylinderCc + totalClearanceCc) / totalClearanceCc).toFixed(2);

        // 4. Rod-to-Stroke Ratio & Angularity
        const rodStrokeRatio = +(rodLength / stroke).toFixed(3);
        const maxRodAngleDeg = +(Math.asin((stroke / 2) / rodLength) * (180 / Math.PI)).toFixed(1);

        // 5. Camshaft & Valvetrain Coordination
        const camData = {
          rv: { name: "RV / High-Torque Hydraulic", intakeDur050: 212, exhDur050: 218, lobeLift: 0.300, baseHp: 310, baseTq: 395, hpRpm: 4800, tqRpm: 3200, ve: 0.84, recStall: 1800, ivcDeg: 38 },
          street: { name: "Street / Strip Hydraulic Roller (Ray's Spec)", intakeDur050: 224, exhDur050: 230, lobeLift: 0.340, baseHp: 385, baseTq: 415, hpRpm: 5600, tqRpm: 3800, ve: 0.90, recStall: 2400, ivcDeg: 44 },
          radical: { name: "Radical Solid Roller", intakeDur050: 242, exhDur050: 248, lobeLift: 0.370, baseHp: 445, baseTq: 425, hpRpm: 6400, tqRpm: 4600, ve: 0.98, recStall: 3500, ivcDeg: 52 }
        }[camProfile];

        // Total Valve Lift with selected Rocker Ratio
        const totalValveLift = +(camData.lobeLift * rockerRatio).toFixed(3);

        // Dynamic Compression Ratio (DCR factoring in Intake Valve Closing point)
        const effectiveStroke = stroke * (1 - (camData.ivcDeg / 180) * 0.45);
        const effectiveCylCc = (Math.PI / 4) * Math.pow(bore, 2) * effectiveStroke * 16.3871;
        const dynamicCR = +((effectiveCylCc + totalClearanceCc) / totalClearanceCc).toFixed(2);

        // 6. Induction & Airflow Coordination
        const intakeData = {
          dualplane_rpm: { name: "Edelbrock Performer RPM Dual-Plane", runnerCc: 195, flowCfm: 265, hpMult: 1.00, tqMult: 1.00 },
          singleplane_victor: { name: "Edelbrock Victor Jr. Single-Plane", runnerCc: 215, flowCfm: 295, hpMult: 1.06, tqMult: 0.96 },
          tunnelram_dual: { name: "Weiand Hi-Ram Dual-Quad Tunnel Ram", runnerCc: 235, flowCfm: 330, hpMult: 1.12, tqMult: 0.94 }
        }[selectedIntake];

        const peakCfmDemand = Math.round(((displacementCi * camData.hpRpm) / 3456) * camData.ve);

        // 7. Live Dyno Performance Outputs
        const timingFactor = ignitionTiming === 36 ? 1.0 : ignitionTiming > 38 ? 0.92 : 1.0 - (36 - ignitionTiming) * 0.015;
        const afrFactor = Math.max(0.88, 1.0 - Math.pow(targetAFR - 12.9, 2) * 0.04);
        const peakHp = Math.round(camData.baseHp * (staticCR / 9.90) * intakeData.hpMult * timingFactor * afrFactor);
        const peakTq = Math.round(camData.baseTq * (displacementCi / 350.4) * intakeData.tqMult * timingFactor * afrFactor);

        return {
          displacementCi,
          displacementL,
          cylinderCc,
          quenchDistance,
          staticCR,
          dynamicCR,
          rodStrokeRatio,
          maxRodAngleDeg,
          camData,
          totalValveLift,
          intakeData,
          peakCfmDemand,
          peakHp,
          peakTq,
          knockAlert: ignitionTiming > 38
        };
      }, [bore, stroke, rodLength, deckHeight, deckClearance, gasketThickness, chamberCc, pistonReliefCc, camProfile, rockerRatio, selectedIntake, ignitionTiming, targetAFR]);

      // Automatically recommend torque converter stall speed when camshaft changes
      useEffect(() => {
        setStallSpeed(coordinatedSpecs.camData.recStall);
      }, [camProfile]);

      const currentTrans = TRANSMISSIONS_DB[selectedTrans] || TRANSMISSIONS_DB.th350;

      // Speed in Gear Table
      const speedInGearTable = useMemo(() => {
        return currentTrans.ratios.map((ratio, idx) => {
          const totalReduction = ratio * rearGear;
          const mphAt2500 = Math.round((2500 * tireDiameter) / (totalReduction * 336));
          const mphAt5500 = Math.round((5500 * tireDiameter) / (totalReduction * 336));
          const cruiseRpmAt65 = Math.round((65 * totalReduction * 336) / tireDiameter);
          return { gear: idx + 1, ratio, totalReduction, mphAt2500, mphAt5500, cruiseRpmAt65 };
        });
      }, [currentTrans, rearGear, tireDiameter]);

      // Mutable Refs for Real-Time 60fps Loop
      const isRunningRef = useRef(false);
      const rpmRef = useRef(850);
      const explodedAmountRef = useRef(0);
      useEffect(() => { isRunningRef.current = isRunning; }, [isRunning]);
      useEffect(() => { rpmRef.current = rpm; }, [rpm]);
      useEffect(() => { explodedAmountRef.current = explodedAmount; }, [explodedAmount]);

      const canvasContainerRef = useRef(null);

      // --- 3D ENGINE VIEWPORT (COORDINATED WITH REAL-TIME STROKE & ROD LENGTH) ---
      useEffect(() => {
        if (activeTab !== 'block3d') return;
        const container = canvasContainerRef.current;
        if (!container) return;

        const winW = window.innerWidth || 800;
        const winH = window.innerHeight || 600;
        const safeH = Math.max(480, winH - (headerRef.current?.offsetHeight || 140));

        const initialW = Math.max(container.clientWidth || winW, 320);
        const initialH = Math.max(container.clientHeight || safeH, 300);

        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        scene.background = new THREE.Color(viewMode === 'technical' ? 0x07111a : 0x14181c);

        let renderer;
        try {
          renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true, alpha: false });
        } catch (e1) {
          renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: false });
        }
        renderer.localClippingEnabled = true;
        renderer.setSize(initialW, initialH);
        renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2));
        container.innerHTML = '';
        container.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.85));
        const dLight1 = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1.2);
        dLight1.position.set(20, 25, 20);
        scene.add(dLight1);
        const dLight2 = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x90b0ff, 0.6);
        dLight2.position.set(-20, 15, -20);
        scene.add(dLight2);

        const grid = new THREE.GridHelper(30, 30, 0x00f0ff, 0x223344);
        grid.position.y = -5.5;
        scene.add(grid);

        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(45, initialW / initialH, 0.1, 1000);
        camera.position.set(18, 14, 22);
        camera.lookAt(0, 1.0, 0);

        const controls = setupUniversalOrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement, new THREE.Vector3(0, 1.0, 0));

        let activeClippingPlanes = [];
        if (cutawayMode === 'rightBank') {
          activeClippingPlanes = [new THREE.Plane(new THREE.Vector3(-1, -0.6, 0).normalize(), 0.8)];
        } else if (cutawayMode === 'centerLongitudinal') {
          activeClippingPlanes = [new THREE.Plane(new THREE.Vector3(-1, 0, 0), 0.2)];
        }

        const isGhost = viewMode === 'ghost';
        const materials = {
          blockCasting: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
            color: 0xd83b01,
            roughness: 0.75,
            metalness: 0.18,
            transparent: isGhost,
            opacity: isGhost ? 0.35 : 1.0,
            clippingPlanes: activeClippingPlanes
          }),
          aluminum: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xc4cbd2, roughness: 0.35, metalness: 0.65 }),
          cranksteel: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x8a939e, roughness: 0.15, metalness: 0.9 }),
          pistonAlloy: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xd8dee4, roughness: 0.2, metalness: 0.8 }),
          valvetrain: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x0284c7, roughness: 0.25, metalness: 0.85 }),
          chrome: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xffffff, roughness: 0.1, metalness: 0.95 })
        };

        const engineGroup = new THREE.Group();
        const parts = {};

        // Kinematic scaling linked to exact coordinated state!
        const boreRadius = (bore / 4.0) * 1.15;
        const crankRadius = (stroke / 3.48) * (3.480 * 0.35);
        const scaledRodLen = (rodLength / 5.70) * (5.700 * 0.35);

        // Block
        const block = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(6.4, 3.8, 12), materials.blockCasting);
        block.position.y = -0.5;
        engineGroup.add(block);
        parts.block = block;

        // Crank
        const crank = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.7, 0.7, 13.5, 20), materials.cranksteel);
        crank.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
        crank.position.y = -1.0;
        engineGroup.add(crank);
        parts.crank = crank;

        // Pistons & Connecting Rods
        const pistonNodes = [];
        for (let p = 0; p < 8; p++) {
          const isRight = p % 2 === 0;
          const bankSign = isRight ? 1 : -1;
          const cylIndex = Math.floor(p / 2);

          const pGroup = new THREE.Group();
          pGroup.position.set(bankSign * 1.8, 1.2, -4.5 + cylIndex * 3.0 + (isRight ? -0.2 : 0.2));
          pGroup.rotation.z = -bankSign * (Math.PI / 4);

          const piston = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(boreRadius, boreRadius, 1.1, 20), materials.pistonAlloy);
          piston.position.y = 1.6;
          pGroup.add(piston);

          const rod = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.35, scaledRodLen, 0.22), materials.cranksteel);
          rod.position.y = 0.3;
          pGroup.add(rod);

          engineGroup.add(pGroup);
          pistonNodes.push({ group: pGroup, angleOffset: (p * Math.PI) / 4, baseY: 1.2 });
        }

        // Heads & Valvetrain
        const headsGroup = new THREE.Group();
        [-1, 1].forEach((side) => {
          const head = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(3.6, 2.6, 12.2), materials.aluminum);
          head.position.set(side * 3.8, 3.2, 0);
          head.rotation.z = side * (-Math.PI / 4);
          headsGroup.add(head);

          const vc = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(2.8, 1.6, 11.6), materials.chrome);
          vc.position.y = 2.0;
          head.add(vc);
        });
        engineGroup.add(headsGroup);
        parts.heads = headsGroup;

        // Intake & Carb
        const intake = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(4.2, 2.0, 9.6), materials.aluminum);
        intake.position.set(0, 3.4, 0);
        engineGroup.add(intake);

        const carb = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(2.6, 1.5, 2.8), materials.valvetrain);
        carb.position.set(0, 5.2, 0);
        engineGroup.add(carb);

        const airFilter = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(3.6, 3.6, 1.4, 28), materials.chrome);
        airFilter.position.set(0, 6.5, 0);
        engineGroup.add(airFilter);

        scene.add(engineGroup);
        renderer.render(scene, camera);

        let animId;
        let lastTime = performance.now();
        const animate = (now) => {
          animId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
          const dt = Math.min((now - lastTime) / 1000, 0.1);
          lastTime = now;

          if (controls.update) controls.update();

          const f = explodedAmountRef.current;
          if (parts.heads) parts.heads.children[0].position.set(-3.8 - f * 4.5, 3.2 + f * 4.5, 0);
          if (parts.heads) parts.heads.children[1].position.set(3.8 + f * 4.5, 3.2 + f * 4.5, 0);

          if (isRunningRef.current) {
            const radPerSec = (rpmRef.current / 60) * 2 * Math.PI;
            if (parts.crank) parts.crank.rotation.z += radPerSec * dt;

            pistonNodes.forEach((node) => {
              const theta = (parts.crank ? parts.crank.rotation.z : 0) + node.angleOffset;
              const disp = (crankRadius * Math.cos(theta)) + 
                           Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, Math.pow(scaledRodLen, 2) - Math.pow(crankRadius * Math.sin(theta), 2))) - scaledRodLen;
              node.group.position.y = node.baseY + disp * 0.45;
            });
          }

          renderer.render(scene, camera);
        };
        animate(performance.now());

        return () => {
          cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
          if (controls.dispose) controls.dispose();
          renderer.dispose();
        };
      }, [activeTab, viewMode, cutawayMode, bore, stroke, rodLength]);

      return (
        <div className="w-full min-h-screen flex flex-col bg-chevyDark text-gray-200">
          
          {/* TOP MASTER COORDINATION HEADER */}
          <header ref={headerRef} className="flex-shrink-0 bg-chevyPanel border-b border-gray-700 px-3 py-2 flex flex-col gap-2 z-20 shadow-lg">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2.5">
                <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded bg-chevyOrange flex items-center justify-center font-black text-sm text-white shadow-md">
                  350
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h1 className="font-bold text-sm tracking-wide text-white flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    COORDINATED ENGINE STUDIO <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-chevyOrange/20 text-chevyOrange border border-chevyOrange/40 font-mono">BI-DIRECTIONAL SYNC</span>
                  </h1>
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-mono">
                    Ray's Baseline: {bore.toFixed(3)}" Bore × {stroke.toFixed(3)}" Stroke | {rodLength.toFixed(3)}" Rod | {chamberCc}cc Heads | .039" Gasket | Quench {coordinatedSpecs.quenchDistance}" | CR {coordinatedSpecs.staticCR}:1
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* ALL COORDINATED COMPONENT TABS */}
              <nav className="flex space-x-1 overflow-x-auto max-w-full">
                {[
                  { id: 'block3d', label: '1. 3D Studio', icon: '⚙️' },
                  { id: 'rotating', label: '2. Block & Rotating', icon: '🧱' },
                  { id: 'valvetrain', label: '3. Valvetrain & Cam', icon: '🌪️' },
                  { id: 'induction', label: '4. Induction & Carb', icon: '⚡' },
                  { id: 'ignition', label: '5. Ignition & Timing', icon: '🔋' },
                  { id: 'trans', label: '6. Transmission (28 Units)', icon: '🏎️' },
                  { id: 'dyno', label: '7. Live Dyno Test Cell', icon: '📊' },
                  { id: 'shop', label: '8. Specs & BOM Counter', icon: '🏬' }
                ].map((tab) => (
                  <button
                    key={tab.id}
                    onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.id)}
                    className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-xs font-semibold whitespace-nowrap transition-all flex items-center gap-1 ${
                      activeTab === tab.id
                        ? 'bg-chevyOrange text-white shadow-md'
                        : 'text-gray-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-gray-800'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <span>{tab.icon}</span>
                    <span>{tab.label}</span>
                  </button>
                ))}
              </nav>
            </div>

            {/* LIVE SYSTEM VITALS STATUS BAR */}
            <div className="bg-chevyDark/90 p-2 rounded-lg border border-gray-700/80 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs font-mono">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
                <div><span className="text-gray-400">DISPLACEMENT:</span> <span className="text-white font-bold">{coordinatedSpecs.displacementCi} CID ({coordinatedSpecs.displacementL}L)</span></div>
                <div><span className="text-gray-400">QUENCH:</span> <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold">{coordinatedSpecs.quenchDistance}" (PASS)</span></div>
                <div><span className="text-gray-400">STATIC CR:</span> <span className="text-chevyGold font-bold">{coordinatedSpecs.staticCR}:1</span></div>
                <div><span className="text-gray-400">DYNAMIC CR:</span> <span className="text-chevyGold font-bold">{coordinatedSpecs.dynamicCR}:1</span></div>
                <div><span className="text-gray-400">ROD/STROKE:</span> <span className="text-cadCyan font-bold">{coordinatedSpecs.rodStrokeRatio}:1</span></div>
                <div><span className="text-gray-400">DYNO PEAK:</span> <span className="text-chevyOrange font-bold">{coordinatedSpecs.peakHp} HP / {coordinatedSpecs.peakTq} TQ</span></div>
              </div>

              <button
                onClick={() => {
                  setBore(4.000); setStroke(3.480); setRodLength(5.700); setDeckHeight(9.025);
                  setDeckClearance(0.015); setGasketThickness(0.039); setChamberCc(64.0);
                  setCamProfile('street'); setSelectedIntake('dualplane_rpm'); setIgnitionTiming(36);
                }}
                className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[11px] font-bold border border-chevyOrange bg-chevyOrange/20 text-chevyOrange hover:bg-chevyOrange hover:text-white"
              >
                Reset Ray's Confirmed Baseline
              </button>
            </div>
          </header>

          {/* MAIN CONTENT AREA */}
          <main className="flex-1 w-full relative">
            
            {/* TAB 1: 3D MASTER STUDIO */}
            {activeTab === 'block3d' && (
              <div style={{ position: 'relative', width: '100%', height: `calc(100vh - ${headerHeight}px)`, minHeight: '480px' }} className="overflow-hidden blueprint-grid">
                <div ref={canvasContainerRef} style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 0, left: 0, width: '100%', height: '100%', touchAction: 'none' }} className="cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing" />

                {/* 3D Top-Left Mode Controls */}
                <div className="absolute top-3 left-3 z-10 flex flex-wrap gap-2 text-xs font-mono">
                  <div className="bg-chevyPanel/95 p-1 rounded-lg border border-chevyOrange flex items-center gap-1 shadow-xl">
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-chevyGold font-bold px-1">CUTAWAY:</span>
                    <button onClick={() => setCutawayMode('none')} className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded ${cutawayMode === 'none' ? 'bg-chevyOrange text-white' : 'text-gray-400'}`}>Solid</button>
                    <button onClick={() => setCutawayMode('rightBank')} className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded ${cutawayMode === 'rightBank' ? 'bg-chevyOrange text-white' : 'text-gray-400'}`}>Right Bank</button>
                    <button onClick={() => setCutawayMode('centerLongitudinal')} className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded ${cutawayMode === 'centerLongitudinal' ? 'bg-chevyOrange text-white' : 'text-gray-400'}`}>Centerline</button>
                  </div>

                  <button
                    onClick={() => setIsRunning(!isRunning)}
                    className={`px-3 py-1 font-bold rounded shadow-xl border flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                      isRunning ? 'bg-emerald-600 border-emerald-400 text-white animate-pulse' : 'bg-chevyPanel border-gray-700 text-gray-300'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <span>{isRunning ? '⏹ STOP KINEMATICS' : '▶ RUN CYCLE ACTION'}</span>
                  </button>
                </div>

                {/* Exploded Disassembly Slider */}
                <div className="absolute bottom-4 left-4 right-4 sm:right-auto sm:w-96 z-10 bg-chevyPanel/95 backdrop-blur border border-gray-700 rounded-xl p-3 shadow-2xl space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-gray-700 pb-1.5">
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-bold tracking-wider text-gray-300 font-mono">EXPLODED DISASSEMBLY VIEW</span>
                    <span className="text-xs font-mono text-chevyOrange font-bold">{Math.round(explodedAmount * 100)}%</span>
                  </div>
                  <input
                    type="range" min="0" max="1" step="0.01"
                    value={explodedAmount}
                    onChange={(e) => setExplodedAmount(parseFloat(e.target.value))}
                    className="w-full accent-chevyOrange cursor-pointer h-2"
                  />
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs pt-1 font-mono">
                    <span className="text-gray-400">Simulation RPM:</span>
                    <span className="font-mono text-chevyGold font-bold">{rpm} RPM</span>
                  </div>
                  <input
                    type="range" min="600" max="6500" step="50"
                    value={rpm}
                    onChange={(e) => setRpm(parseInt(e.target.value))}
                    className="w-full accent-chevyGold cursor-pointer h-2"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* TAB 2: BLOCK & ROTATING ASSEMBLY WORKSPACE */}
            {activeTab === 'rotating' && (
              <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 max-w-6xl mx-auto w-full space-y-5 font-mono text-xs">
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center pb-2 border-b border-gray-700">
                  <div>
                    <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-white uppercase tracking-wider font-sans">BLOCK & ROTATING ASSEMBLY CONFIGURATOR</h2>
                    <p className="text-gray-400 mt-0.5">Directly governs Displacement, Mean Piston Speed, and Rod Angularity.</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-cadCyan font-bold text-sm bg-cadCyan/10 px-3 py-1 rounded border border-cadCyan/30">
                    {coordinatedSpecs.displacementCi} CID / {coordinatedSpecs.displacementL} LITERS
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                  {/* Cylinder Bore */}
                  <div className="bg-chevyPanel p-4 rounded-xl border border-gray-800 space-y-2">
                    <div className="flex justify-between">
                      <span className="text-gray-400 font-bold">CYLINDER BORE:</span>
                      <span className="text-chevyOrange font-bold">{bore.toFixed(3)}"</span>
                    </div>
                    <input type="range" min="3.900" max="4.155" step="0.005" value={bore} onChange={e => setBore(parseFloat(e.target.value))} className="w-full accent-chevyOrange cursor-pointer" />
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-sans">Standard 350 is 4.000". .030" overbore = 4.030" (355ci).</p>
                  </div>

                  {/* Crankshaft Stroke */}
                  <div className="bg-chevyPanel p-4 rounded-xl border border-gray-800 space-y-2">
                    <div className="flex justify-between">
                      <span className="text-gray-400 font-bold">CRANKSHAFT STROKE:</span>
                      <span className="text-chevyGold font-bold">{stroke.toFixed(3)}"</span>
                    </div>
                    <input type="range" min="3.000" max="4.000" step="0.005" value={stroke} onChange={e => setStroke(parseFloat(e.target.value))} className="w-full accent-chevyGold cursor-pointer" />
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-sans">Ray's 350 spec is 3.480". 383 stroker uses 3.750" stroke.</p>
                  </div>

                  {/* Connecting Rod Length (Ray's Spec) */}
                  <div className="bg-chevyPanel p-4 rounded-xl border border-gray-800 space-y-2">
                    <div className="flex justify-between">
                      <span className="text-gray-400 font-bold">CONNECTING ROD LENGTH:</span>
                      <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold">{rodLength.toFixed(3)}"</span>
                    </div>
                    <input type="range" min="5.565" max="6.125" step="0.005" value={rodLength} onChange={e => setRodLength(parseFloat(e.target.value))} className="w-full accent-emerald-400 cursor-pointer" />
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-sans">Ray's confirmed standard is 5.700" C-to-C.</p>
                  </div>

                  {/* Deck Height */}
                  <div className="bg-chevyPanel p-4 rounded-xl border border-gray-800 space-y-2">
                    <div className="flex justify-between">
                      <span className="text-gray-400 font-bold">BLOCK DECK HEIGHT:</span>
                      <span className="text-white font-bold">{deckHeight.toFixed(3)}"</span>
                    </div>
                    <input type="range" min="9.000" max="9.050" step="0.005" value={deckHeight} onChange={e => setDeckHeight(parseFloat(e.target.value))} className="w-full accent-white cursor-pointer" />
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-sans">Ray's confirmed standard deck is 9.025".</p>
                  </div>

                  {/* Piston-To-Deck Clearance */}
                  <div className="bg-chevyPanel p-4 rounded-xl border border-gray-800 space-y-2">
                    <div className="flex justify-between">
                      <span className="text-gray-400 font-bold">DECK CLEARANCE (IN-THE-HOLE):</span>
                      <span className="text-cadCyan font-bold">{deckClearance.toFixed(3)}"</span>
                    </div>
                    <input type="range" min="0.000" max="0.035" step="0.001" value={deckClearance} onChange={e => setDeckClearance(parseFloat(e.target.value))} className="w-full accent-cadCyan cursor-pointer" />
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-sans">Ray's confirmed deck clearance is 0.015". Zero-decking = 0.000".</p>
                  </div>

                  {/* Compressed Head Gasket */}
                  <div className="bg-chevyPanel p-4 rounded-xl border border-gray-800 space-y-2">
                    <div className="flex justify-between">
                      <span className="text-gray-400 font-bold">GASKET THICKNESS:</span>
                      <span className="text-cadCyan font-bold">{gasketThickness.toFixed(3)}"</span>
                    </div>
                    <input type="range" min="0.020" max="0.055" step="0.001" value={gasketThickness} onChange={e => setGasketThickness(parseFloat(e.target.value))} className="w-full accent-cadCyan cursor-pointer" />
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-sans">Ray's confirmed gasket is 0.039" compressed.</p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Coordinated Mechanical Calculations Output Table */}
                <div className="bg-chevyPanel rounded-xl border border-gray-800 p-4">
                  <h3 className="font-bold text-white uppercase text-[11px] mb-3">COORDINATED ROTATING KINEMATICS</h3>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
                    <div className="bg-chevyDark p-2.5 rounded border border-gray-800">
                      <div className="text-gray-500">ROD/STROKE RATIO:</div>
                      <div className="text-base font-bold text-cadCyan mt-0.5">{coordinatedSpecs.rodStrokeRatio}:1</div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-gray-400">Target: 1.55 to 1.75</div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="bg-chevyDark p-2.5 rounded border border-gray-800">
                      <div className="text-gray-500">MAX ROD ANGULARITY:</div>
                      <div className="text-base font-bold text-cadCyan mt-0.5">{coordinatedSpecs.maxRodAngleDeg}°</div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-gray-400">Side wall thrust load</div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="bg-chevyDark p-2.5 rounded border border-gray-800">
                      <div className="text-gray-500">PISTON SPEED @ 6000:</div>
                      <div className="text-base font-bold text-emerald-400 mt-0.5">{Math.round((2 * stroke * 6000) / 12)} FPM</div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-gray-400">Forged limit: &lt; 4,500 FPM</div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="bg-chevyDark p-2.5 rounded border border-emerald-500/40">
                      <div className="text-emerald-400 font-bold">QUENCH VERIFICATION:</div>
                      <div className="text-base font-bold text-emerald-400 mt-0.5">{coordinatedSpecs.quenchDistance}"</div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-gray-400">.039" gasket + .015" deck</div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* TAB 3: VALVETRAIN & CAMSHAFT WORKSPACE */}
            {activeTab === 'valvetrain' && (
              <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 max-w-6xl mx-auto w-full space-y-5 font-mono text-xs">
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center pb-2 border-b border-gray-700">
                  <div>
                    <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-white uppercase tracking-wider font-sans">VALVETRAIN, CAMSHAFT & HEADS COORDINATION</h2>
                    <p className="text-gray-400 mt-0.5">Controls Dynamic Compression Ratio (DCR) and RPM ceiling.</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-chevyGold font-bold text-sm bg-chevyGold/10 px-3 py-1 rounded border border-chevyGold/30">
                    STATIC: {coordinatedSpecs.staticCR}:1 | DYNAMIC: {coordinatedSpecs.dynamicCR}:1
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                  {/* Camshaft Profile */}
                  <div className="bg-chevyPanel p-4 rounded-xl border border-gray-800 space-y-2">
                    <label className="text-gray-400 font-bold block">CAMSHAFT PROFILE:</label>
                    <select value={camProfile} onChange={e => setCamProfile(e.target.value)} className="w-full bg-chevyDark border border-chevyOrange rounded p-2 text-white font-bold">
                      <option value="rv">RV / High Torque (212°/218° @ .050")</option>
                      <option value="street">Street / Strip Roller (224°/230° @ .050" - Ray's Spec)</option>
                      <option value="radical">Radical Solid Roller (242°/248° @ .050")</option>
                    </select>
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-sans">Automatically coordinates with recommended torque converter stall!</p>
                  </div>

                  {/* Cylinder Head Chamber Volume (Ray's 64cc Baseline) */}
                  <div className="bg-chevyPanel p-4 rounded-xl border border-gray-800 space-y-2">
                    <div className="flex justify-between">
                      <span className="text-gray-400 font-bold">CHAMBER VOLUME:</span>
                      <span className="text-chevyGold font-bold">{chamberCc} cc</span>
                    </div>
                    <select value={chamberCc} onChange={e => setChamberCc(parseFloat(e.target.value))} className="w-full bg-chevyDark border border-gray-700 rounded p-2 text-white">
                      <option value={64.0}>64.0 cc (Ray's Confirmed Baseline)</option>
                      <option value={70.0}>70.0 cc (Large Chamber Aluminum)</option>
                      <option value={76.0}>76.0 cc (Smog Era Cast Iron)</option>
                    </select>
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-sans">Directly determines Static Compression Ratio.</p>
                  </div>

                  {/* Rocker Arm Ratio */}
                  <div className="bg-chevyPanel p-4 rounded-xl border border-gray-800 space-y-2">
                    <div className="flex justify-between">
                      <span className="text-gray-400 font-bold">ROCKER ARM RATIO:</span>
                      <span className="text-cadCyan font-bold">{rockerRatio}:1</span>
                    </div>
                    <select value={rockerRatio} onChange={e => setRockerRatio(parseFloat(e.target.value))} className="w-full bg-chevyDark border border-gray-700 rounded p-2 text-white">
                      <option value={1.5}>1.5:1 (Standard GM)</option>
                      <option value={1.6}>1.6:1 (High-Lift Billet Roller)</option>
                    </select>
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-sans">Total Valve Lift: {coordinatedSpecs.totalValveLift}"</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* TAB 4: INDUCTION & CARBURETION WORKSPACE */}
            {activeTab === 'induction' && (
              <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 max-w-6xl mx-auto w-full space-y-5 font-mono text-xs">
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center pb-2 border-b border-gray-700">
                  <div>
                    <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-white uppercase tracking-wider font-sans">INDUCTION, MANIFOLD & FUEL FLOW</h2>
                    <p className="text-gray-400 mt-0.5">Airflow capacity balanced against {coordinatedSpecs.displacementCi} CID demand.</p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                  <div className="bg-chevyPanel p-4 rounded-xl border border-gray-800 space-y-2">
                    <label className="text-gray-400 font-bold block">INTAKE MANIFOLD ARCHITECTURE:</label>
                    <select value={selectedIntake} onChange={e => setSelectedIntake(e.target.value)} className="w-full bg-chevyDark border border-cadCyan rounded p-2 text-white font-bold">
                      <option value="dualplane_rpm">Edelbrock Performer RPM Dual-Plane (195cc / 265 CFM)</option>
                      <option value="singleplane_victor">Edelbrock Victor Jr. Single-Plane (215cc / 295 CFM)</option>
                      <option value="tunnelram_dual">Weiand Hi-Ram Dual-Quad Tunnel Ram (235cc / 330 CFM)</option>
                    </select>
                  </div>

                  <div className="bg-chevyPanel p-4 rounded-xl border border-gray-800 space-y-2">
                    <label className="text-gray-400 font-bold block">CARBURETOR FLOW SIZING:</label>
                    <select value={carbCfm} onChange={e => setCarbCfm(parseInt(e.target.value))} className="w-full bg-chevyDark border border-gray-700 rounded p-2 text-white font-bold">
                      <option value={600}>600 CFM (Crisp Street Throttle)</option>
                      <option value={650}>650 CFM (Ray's Confirmed Baseline)</option>
                      <option value={750}>750 CFM (High-RPM Double Pumper)</option>
                      <option value={900}>900 CFM (Dual-Quad Tunnel Ram)</option>
                    </select>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* TAB 5: IGNITION & TIMING WORKSPACE */}
            {activeTab === 'ignition' && (
              <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 max-w-6xl mx-auto w-full space-y-5 font-mono text-xs">
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center pb-2 border-b border-gray-700">
                  <div>
                    <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-white uppercase tracking-wider font-sans">IGNITION ADVANCE & SPARK TIMING</h2>
                    <p className="text-gray-400 mt-0.5">Live detonation detection and spark curve coordination.</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className={`font-bold px-3 py-1 rounded border ${coordinatedSpecs.knockAlert ? 'bg-red-500 text-white animate-ping' : 'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/40'}`}>
                    {coordinatedSpecs.knockAlert ? 'DETONATION / KNOCK DETECTED' : 'SAFE ADVANCE ENVELOPE'}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="bg-chevyPanel p-4 rounded-xl border border-gray-800 space-y-3">
                  <div className="flex justify-between">
                    <span className="text-gray-400 font-bold">TOTAL TIMING ADVANCE (@ 3,000 RPM):</span>
                    <span className="text-chevyGold font-bold text-sm">{ignitionTiming}° BTDC</span>
                  </div>
                  <input type="range" min="26" max="44" step="1" value={ignitionTiming} onChange={e => setIgnitionTiming(parseInt(e.target.value))} className="w-full accent-chevyGold cursor-pointer" />
                  <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px] text-gray-500">
                    <span>26° (Retard)</span>
                    <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold">36° Optimal (Ray's Spec)</span>
                    <span>44° (Severe Detonation)</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* TAB 6: TRANSMISSION & DRIVETRAIN (28 UNITS) */}
            {activeTab === 'trans' && (
              <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 max-w-6xl mx-auto w-full space-y-5 font-mono text-xs">
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center pb-2 border-b border-gray-700">
                  <div>
                    <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-white uppercase tracking-wider font-sans">TRANSMISSION & DRIVETRAIN COORDINATION</h2>
                    <p className="text-gray-400 mt-0.5">Matched stall speed auto-syncs with Camshaft ({coordinatedSpecs.camData.name}).</p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                  <div className="bg-chevyPanel p-4 rounded-xl border border-chevyOrange space-y-2">
                    <label className="text-gray-400 font-bold block">TRANSMISSION SELECTION:</label>
                    <select value={selectedTrans} onChange={e => setSelectedTrans(e.target.value)} className="w-full bg-chevyDark border border-gray-600 rounded p-2 text-white font-bold">
                      {Object.values(TRANSMISSIONS_DB).map(t => (
                        <option key={t.id} value={t.id}>[{t.type}] {t.name}</option>
                      ))}
                    </select>
                  </div>

                  <div className="bg-chevyPanel p-4 rounded-xl border border-gray-800 space-y-2">
                    <div className="flex justify-between">
                      <span className="text-gray-400 font-bold">CONVERTER STALL SPEED:</span>
                      <span className="text-chevyGold font-bold">{stallSpeed} RPM</span>
                    </div>
                    <input type="range" min="1600" max="4500" step="100" value={stallSpeed} onChange={e => setStallSpeed(parseInt(e.target.value))} className="w-full accent-chevyGold cursor-pointer" />
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500">Auto-calculated recommended stall: {coordinatedSpecs.camData.recStall} RPM.</p>
                  </div>

                  <div className="bg-chevyPanel p-4 rounded-xl border border-gray-800 space-y-2">
                    <div className="flex justify-between">
                      <span className="text-gray-400 font-bold">REAR AXLE GEAR RATIO:</span>
                      <span className="text-cadCyan font-bold">{rearGear}:1</span>
                    </div>
                    <select value={rearGear} onChange={e => setRearGear(parseFloat(e.target.value))} className="w-full bg-chevyDark border border-gray-700 rounded p-2 text-white">
                      <option value={3.08}>3.08:1 (Highway Cruiser)</option>
                      <option value={3.42}>3.42:1 (Street Performance)</option>
                      <option value={3.73}>3.73:1 (Street / Strip Ideal)</option>
                      <option value={4.10}>4.10:1 (Drag Strip Aggressive)</option>
                    </select>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Speed in Gear Table */}
                <div className="bg-chevyPanel p-4 rounded-xl border border-gray-800">
                  <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-white uppercase mb-2">CALCULATED ROAD SPEED & REDUCTION RATIOS</h3>
                  <table className="w-full text-left">
                    <thead className="text-gray-400 border-b border-gray-700">
                      <tr>
                        <th className="py-1">GEAR</th>
                        <th className="py-1">RATIO</th>
                        <th className="py-1">TOTAL RATIO</th>
                        <th className="py-1 text-emerald-400">MPH @ 5,500 RPM</th>
                        <th className="py-1 text-gray-400">CRUISE RPM @ 65 MPH</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-800">
                      {speedInGearTable.map(r => (
                        <tr key={r.gear}>
                          <td className="py-1 text-white font-bold">Gear {r.gear}</td>
                          <td className="py-1 text-chevyGold">{r.ratio.toFixed(2)}:1</td>
                          <td className="py-1">{r.totalReduction.toFixed(2)}:1</td>
                          <td className="py-1 text-emerald-400 font-bold">{r.mphAt5500} MPH</td>
                          <td className="py-1 text-gray-300">{r.cruiseRpmAt65 > 5500 ? 'N/A' : `${r.cruiseRpmAt65} RPM`}</td>
                        </tr>
                      ))}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* TAB 7: LIVE DYNO TEST CELL */}
            {activeTab === 'dyno' && (
              <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 max-w-6xl mx-auto w-full space-y-5 font-mono text-xs">
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center pb-2 border-b border-gray-700">
                  <div>
                    <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-white uppercase tracking-wider font-sans">LIVE WATER-BRAKE DYNO TEST CELL</h2>
                    <p className="text-gray-400 mt-0.5">Full pull sweep reflecting {coordinatedSpecs.displacementCi} CID & {coordinatedSpecs.staticCR}:1 CR.</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex gap-3">
                    <div className="bg-chevyPanel px-3 py-1 rounded border border-gray-700 text-center">
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-gray-400">PEAK HORSEPOWER</div>
                      <div className="text-base font-black text-chevyOrange">{coordinatedSpecs.peakHp} HP</div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="bg-chevyPanel px-3 py-1 rounded border border-gray-700 text-center">
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-gray-400">PEAK TORQUE</div>
                      <div className="text-base font-black text-chevyGold">{coordinatedSpecs.peakTq} FT-LBS</div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="p-4 bg-chevyPanel rounded-xl border border-gray-800">
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-300">ABSORPTION POWER & TORQUE CURVES</span>
                  <div className="relative h-64 w-full mt-3">
                    <svg className="w-full h-full" viewBox="0 0 800 240">
                      {[0, 60, 120, 180, 240].map((y) => (
                        <line key={y} x1="50" y1={y} x2="780" y2={y} stroke="#2a3036" strokeWidth="1" />
                      ))}
                      <line x1="500" y1="0" x2="500" y2="240" stroke="#4a5568" strokeDasharray="4" />
                      <text x="505" y="15" fill="#718096" fontSize="10">5252 RPM Crossover (HP = TQ)</text>
                      <path d="M 50 180 Q 300 80 500 50 T 780 40" fill="none" stroke="#d83b01" strokeWidth="3.5" />
                      <path d="M 50 100 Q 300 40 500 65 T 780 120" fill="none" stroke="#e5a823" strokeWidth="3.5" />
                    </svg>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* TAB 8: BLUEPRINT SPECS, FASTENERS & BOM */}
            {activeTab === 'shop' && (
              <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 max-w-6xl mx-auto w-full space-y-5 font-mono text-xs">
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center pb-2 border-b border-gray-700">
                  <div>
                    <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-white uppercase tracking-wider font-sans">BLUEPRINT SPECS, 17-BOLT SEQUENCE & BOM</h2>
                    <p className="text-gray-400 mt-0.5">Ray's Confirmed Baseline Standards</p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* 17-Bolt Cylinder Head Torquing Pattern */}
                <div className="p-4 bg-chevyPanel rounded-xl border border-gray-800 flex flex-col gap-3">
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-chevyGold">17-Bolt Cylinder Head Tightening Pattern (Stage 1: 25 ft-lbs ➔ Stage 2: 45 ft-lbs ➔ Stage 3: 65 ft-lbs)</span>
                  <div className="p-3 bg-chevyDark rounded-lg flex justify-between items-center max-w-lg mx-auto w-full">
                    {[13, 9, 5, 1, 3, 7, 11, 15, 17].map(n => (
                      <div key={n} className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-chevyOrange flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs text-white">{n}</div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                  <div className="p-3 bg-chevyDark rounded-lg flex justify-between items-center max-w-md mx-auto w-full">
                    {[14, 10, 6, 2, 4, 8, 12, 16].map(n => (
                      <div key={n} className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-chevyGold flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs text-white">{n}</div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Coordinated Bill of Materials */}
                <div className="bg-chevyPanel p-4 rounded-xl border border-gray-800">
                  <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-white uppercase mb-2">ITEMIZED BILL OF MATERIALS (COORDINATED BUILDSHEET)</h3>
                  <table className="w-full text-left">
                    <thead className="bg-chevyDark text-gray-400">
                      <tr>
                        <th className="p-2">SUBSYSTEM</th>
                        <th className="p-2">COMPONENT</th>
                        <th className="p-2">SPECIFICATION</th>
                        <th className="p-2 text-right">EST. COST</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-800">
                      <tr><td className="p-2 font-bold text-white">Block</td><td className="p-2 text-gray-300">Chevy 350 4-Bolt Main Block</td><td className="p-2 text-chevyGold">{bore.toFixed(3)}" Bore / {deckHeight.toFixed(3)}" Deck</td><td className="p-2 text-right text-emerald-400 font-bold">$850.00</td></tr>
                      <tr><td className="p-2 font-bold text-white">Connecting Rods</td><td className="p-2 text-gray-300">Scat Forged 4340 H-Beam</td><td className="p-2 text-chevyGold">{rodLength.toFixed(3)}" C-to-C (Ray's Spec)</td><td className="p-2 text-right text-emerald-400 font-bold">$345.00</td></tr>
                      <tr><td className="p-2 font-bold text-white">Crankshaft</td><td className="p-2 text-gray-300">Forged 4340 Steel Crank</td><td className="p-2 text-chevyGold">{stroke.toFixed(3)}" Stroke</td><td className="p-2 text-right text-emerald-400 font-bold">$490.00</td></tr>
                      <tr><td className="p-2 font-bold text-white">Cylinder Heads</td><td className="p-2 text-gray-300">Edelbrock E-Street Aluminum</td><td className="p-2 text-chevyGold">{chamberCc}cc Chambers (Ray's Spec)</td><td className="p-2 text-right text-emerald-400 font-bold">$1,290.00</td></tr>
                      <tr><td className="p-2 font-bold text-white">Gaskets</td><td className="p-2 text-gray-300">Fel-Pro Performance</td><td className="p-2 text-chevyGold">{gasketThickness.toFixed(3)}" Compressed (Quench: {coordinatedSpecs.quenchDistance}")</td><td className="p-2 text-right text-emerald-400 font-bold">$98.00</td></tr>
                      <tr><td className="p-2 font-bold text-white">Transmission</td><td className="p-2 text-gray-300">{currentTrans.name}</td><td className="p-2 text-chevyGold">{currentTrans.type} ({currentTrans.ratios.join(', ')})</td><td className="p-2 text-right text-emerald-400 font-bold">$1,150.00</td></tr>
                      <tr className="bg-chevyDark font-bold"><td colSpan="3" className="p-2.5 text-right text-white">TOTAL ESTIMATED DRIVETRAIN INVESTMENT:</td><td className="p-2.5 text-right text-chevyGold font-black">$4,223.00</td></tr>
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

          </main>
        </div>
      );
    }

    ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById('root')).render(<SBC350App />);
  </script>
</body>
